name: Extract event-related timeseries
summary: Extracts the BOLD volumes that overlap selected event types from a preprocessed task fMRI run, using the events table and an HRF-convolved regressor from nilearn.
description: Selects the BOLD volumes that fall within the chosen event types: event onsets and durations from the BIDS events.tsv (trial_type, onset, duration, weight columns) are convolved with nilearn's SPM HRF regressor and frames with a positive regressor are kept. Use it to isolate event-related volumes before further analysis. Note: main reads the config keys bold and bold_events, while the registered input sends data and bold_events, so the App may fail to find the BOLD image.

inputs.description: Preprocessed task BOLD image with its BIDS events.tsv (needs trial_type, onset, duration and weight columns).

outputs.description: BOLD image containing only the selected volumes (bold.nii.gz) and the filtered events table (events.tsv).
